title: Planet Labs PBC Q1 fiscal 2027 results
excerpt: Q1 fiscal 2027 revenue was $94.2 million, recurring ACV was 99%, net dollar retention was 113%, RPO was $816.0 million, gross margin was 54%, and fiscal-year revenue guidance was $425-$440 million.
summary: The unchanged SEC-filed results release supplies current growth, recurrence, retention, backlog, margin, cash-generation and revenue-guidance inputs for the three-scenario valuation.
